title: Anker soundcore AeroClip 2: Open-Ear Comfort for Everyday Life

blocks.text: Most people these days spend a good chunk of their time wearing earphones or headphones to listen to their favorite music, podcasts, audio books, and even take calls while on the go.
And while it’s great to have that convenience of being able to do that, you still have to make sure you’re completely aware of things going on in your surroundings as you go through your day.

It’s easy to get distracted by what you listen to for a quick moment, especially when it’s that final chorus in a song you love, or a good punchline from a podcast that makes you laugh hard. These small instances can easily turn from special moments to accidents, which could easily ruin your day.

One of the best ways to still be able to listen to what you want whenever and wherever is to get a solid pair of OWS (Open Wearable Stereo) devices, and one of the best ones out there right now is the Anker soundcore AeroClip 2.
All-day comfort without falling off
Long commutes or morning jogs can be made fun with a bit of music, so a pair that’s comfortable to wear for hours can make or break your day.

The Anker soundcore AeroClip 2’s open ear design clips onto the outer portion of the ear to hang and stay in place. Them falling off won’t be an issue having been precision-modeled using a database of over 2,000 ear profiles, as well as being tested on 1,000+ diverse users.

In addition, its material is durable yet lightweight, having been tested for over 10,000 flex tests and only weighing 6.2 grams per earbud, so you won’t even notice that it’s there while you wear it for hours, which mitigates any form of discomfort.
Enjoying your own little bubble without missing out on the world around you
Poor audio quality adds stress and can sour your mood, of course we don’t want that. Your favorite songs and podcasts should be there to lift you up to get through your day.

Sound-wise, the combination of the Anker soundcore AeroClip 2’s 12mm dual-magnetic drivers, LDAC support (for Android devices), Hi-Res certification, and Anker’s own customizable HearID 5.0 provide a worthwhile listening experience that’s both immersive, yet not too distracting that you’ll lack spatial awareness.

These are also great for fulfilling your fitness era, being able to wear them and set high volumes with hype music playing to pump you up for sprints when running, getting in the zone in padel or tennis, and just going all out.Never missing a beat at work When taking calls for work regardless of when you’re at the office, at home, a cafe, or outdoors, there’s bound to be those loud ambient noises that disrupt an ongoing meeting or make you miss important points discussed.It also gets rough when all your colleagues hear from your end of the call is nothing but construction noises or road rage, so voice isolation in a pair of earbuds is important.

To solve that, the Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 comes with an advanced voice-calling system through its use of the brand’s own THUS™ AI Chip and 6-Sensor Call Technology to extract your voice and make it so the people you talk to only hear you and not the noisy environment around you.This technology earned the device a Guinness World Records certification as the “World’s Clearest Open-Ear Clip-On Earbuds for Calls”.

A proper ambience for resting No matter how strong or energetic a person you are, the daily hustling that you do to get the most out of life can be inevitably draining, so you’ll always need even just a few moments to relax.Coming with built-in white noises, the Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 can enter something called “Nap Mode” with just 3 clicks on the button of either earbud.

In this mode, you can choose from a wide selection of offline white noises that can be downloaded through the Anker app, from ‘rainy alley’ to ‘campfire crackle’, there’s going to be something there for that quick break to meditate or power nap right before getting back to work.
Highly reliable, rain or shine
As human beings, endurance is a quality that’s truly looked up to given how chaotic or peaceful life can be given its unpredictability.

And the Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 is capable of tagging along with you in this adventure we call life.It has ingress protection (IP) rating of IP57, the earbuds will be able to withstand potential damage against dust & other small particles, as well as splashes of water. Sweat and rain are also a few of the things it’s able to endure, making it a great partner to use at the gym, in the courts, and even outdoors during your morning run.
And with up to 8 hours of use per charge for each earbud, and up to 32 hours total with the charging case, these earbuds are ready to last a full week through your day to day grind.
The earbuds are also quick to charge, allowing up to 4 hours of use with just a 10-minute charge.
Seamless Apple integration

Great device compatibility also matters when choosing a pair of earphones to include in your EDC, and the Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 is “The World’s First Open-Ear Clip-On Earbuds with an MFi Certification”.This allows a smoother, more reliable experience and connectivity with iOS devices, ensuring that there won’t be any technical issues that hold you back while going through your day.

A complete OWS packageWhether your day involves commuting, calls, workouts, a lot of moving around, or even taking quick breaks and staying still, the Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 is made to fit in without getting in the way. It lets you keep listening while your day keeps moving.
Price and Availability
The Anker soundcore AeroClip 2 comes in several colors including Burgundy Red, Midnight Black, Cloud White, and Mist Blue.
